newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bayer - no special sup. board meet planned.
newsitem.headline: Bayer - no special sup. board meet planned.

text.p: German chemicals and drugs group Bayer AG on Thursday denied talk its supervisory board will convene for an extraordinary meeting next week.
"That is not true," said a Bayer spokesman in answer to a query. The supervisory board will next meet on January 22.
Bayer also said a newspaper report that it was planning to make a large acquisition that could be worth as much as 20 billion marks is incorrect.

"Bayer's chief executive Manfred Schneider clearly said the company would prefer to make several smaller acquisitions rather than one large one and reports to the contrary are incorrect," the spokesman said.
